nodes.description: CountersUpgradeable.Counter private _IssueCtr; monotonic proposal id counter.
address public bridge; privileged bridge address used by the isBridge modifier.
mapping(uint256 => issueStruct) private issueMap; proposal status, block window, quorum and vote counters.
mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => hasVotedStruct)) private hasVoted; per-voter vote record.
mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint8 => uint256)) private voteWeight; accumulated weight per option.
__VoterUpgradeable_init() internal initializer; sets up roles and ERC20 metadata.
initialize() external initializer; entry point that calls __VoterUpgradeable_init().
_authorizeUpgrade(address) internal override onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE); UUPS upgrade gate.
setBridge(address) onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE); writes the bridge state variable with zero/self checks.
mint(address) isBridge; mints exactly 1 ether voting tokens to an account.
burn(address) isBridge; burns exactly 1 ether voting tokens from an account.
createProposal(uint256,uint64) isBridge isValidquorum; creates an Active proposal and increments _IssueCtr.
vote(uint256,uint8,address) isBridge; records the ballot, accumulates weight and may pass the proposal.
setStatus(uint256) isVotingEnded isBridge; finalises proposal outcome after the voting window.
_setStatus(uint256,uint8,ProposalStatus) internal; writes resultOption/status and emits OnStatusChange.
executeProposal(uint256) isPassed isBridge; marks a passed proposal as Executed.
ballotOf(uint256,address) public view; returns the recorded option of a voter.
weightOf(address) public view; returns token balance as voting weight.
getStatus(uint256) public view; returns issueMap status.
weightedVoteCountsOf(uint256,uint8) public view; returns voteWeight for an option.
fetchIssueMap(uint256) public view; returns the full issueStruct.
fetchIsExpired(uint256) public view; compares block.number against endBlock.
fetchCtr() public view; returns _IssueCtr.current().
_transfer(...) internal override; calls the before-transfer hook then unconditionally reverts (non-transferable token).
_beforeTokenTransfer(...) internal override hook invoked by mint/burn/transfer paths.
ERC20Upgradeable._mint(address,uint256) internal; increases totalSupply and balance, emits Transfer.
ERC20Upgradeable._burn(address,uint256) internal; decreases balance and totalSupply, emits Transfer.
ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._functionDelegateCall(address,bytes) private; performs target.delegatecall(data).
AddressUpgradeable.sendValue(address payable,uint256) internal; forwards ETH with a low-level call.
ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._upgradeToAndCallSecure; sets implementation and delegatecalls the new implementation.
msg.sender (via _msgSender()); used by the isBridge modifier and onlyRole checks.
Block-level timing input; the contract uses block.number (block.timestamp family) for startBlock/endBlock and isNotEnded/isVotingEnded checks.
mint(): _mint(account, 1 ether) privileged token issuance guarded only by the isBridge address comparison.
burn(): _burn(account, 1 ether) privileged token destruction guarded only by the isBridge address comparison.
vote(): voteWeight[issueId][option] = voteWeight[...] + balance and issueMap[issueId].maxVotes += balance weight accumulation.
vote()/setStatus(): (yes * 10000) / totalSupply() percentage computation, division by a supply that can be zero.
target.delegatecall(data) inside _functionDelegateCall; executes attacker-influenced code in this contract's storage context during upgrades.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside AddressUpgradeable.sendValue; external call forwarding all gas.
_setStatus(): privileged mutation of issueMap[issueId].resultOption and .status plus OnStatusChange emission.
endBlock parameter of createProposal; stored as the proposal voting deadline.
quorum parameter of createProposal; validated by isValidquorum (0 < quorum <= 10000).
issueId parameter of vote; selects the proposal mapping entry.
option parameter of vote; restricted to 1 or 2 by isValidOption.
relayer parameter of vote; the voter address whose balance/weight is consumed.
Local variable balance = balanceOf(relayer) in vote.
Local variable yes = voteWeight[issueId][1] in vote.
Local variable yesPercent used in vote to compare against the quorum threshold.
issueId parameter of setStatus.
Local variable yes = voteWeight[issueId][1] in setStatus.
Local variable yesPercent used in setStatus to decide Passed vs Cancelled.
issueId parameter of the internal _setStatus.
option parameter of _setStatus; written into issueMap[issueId].resultOption.
status parameter of _setStatus; written into issueMap[issueId].status.
_b parameter of setBridge; new bridge address stored in the bridge state variable.
account parameter of mint; recipient of the privileged 1 ether mint.
account parameter of burn; target of the privileged 1 ether burn.
issueId parameter of executeProposal.
newImplementation parameter of _authorizeUpgrade; address forwarded to the UUPS upgrade logic.

edges.reason: mint is gated by the isBridge modifier which requires msg.sender == bridge.
burn is gated by the isBridge modifier which requires msg.sender == bridge.
createProposal is gated by the isBridge modifier.
vote is gated by the isBridge modifier; caller identity decides who may cast a ballot for a relayer.
setStatus is gated by the isBridge modifier.
executeProposal is gated by the isBridge modifier.
setBridge is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders via onlyRole.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders via onlyRole.
The bridge state variable is compared against msg.sender in isBridge, controlling vote execution.
The bridge state variable gates privileged minting.
The bridge state variable gates privileged burning.
The bridge state variable gates proposal creation.
isNotEnded compares block.number with issueMap[issueId].endBlock, making vote execution dependent on block timing.
isVotingEnded compares block.number with endBlock, making setStatus dependent on block timing.
createProposal stores block.number into issueStruct.startBlock.
fetchIsExpired returns block.number >= issueMap[_issue].endBlock.
initialize calls __VoterUpgradeable_init.
_setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _msgSender()) grants admin to the initializer caller.
setBridge writes the bridge state variable, changing who may call every isBridge function.
mint triggers the privileged _mint(account, 1 ether) operation.
The mint operation is implemented by ERC20Upgradeable._mint.
burn triggers the privileged _burn(account, 1 ether) operation.
The burn operation is implemented by ERC20Upgradeable._burn.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
The overridden _transfer calls super._beforeTokenTransfer before reverting.
createProposal increments and reads _IssueCtr to derive the new proposal id.
createProposal writes a new issueStruct into issueMap.
vote reads the quorum and updates issueMap[issueId].maxVotes.
vote writes hasVoted[issueId][relayer] before the effects below.
vote reads and writes voteWeight[issueId][option].
vote performs the weight accumulation unsafe operation.
voteWeight[issueId][option] + balance addition accumulates voting weight without overflow protection.
vote computes the yes percentage for the quorum comparison.
The percentage is derived from voteWeight and totalSupply(); a zero or skewed supply distorts the ratio.
vote calls _setStatus when yesPercent exceeds the quorum.
setStatus reads voteWeight[issueId][1].
setStatus repeats the (yes * 10000) / totalSupply() division used for the quorum decision.
setStatus finalises the proposal through _setStatus.
_setStatus writes resultOption and status into issueMap.
_setStatus performs the privileged status write operation.
The status write mutates issueMap[issueId].status and resultOption.
executeProposal sets issueMap[issueId].status to Executed.
_authorizeUpgrade gates the UUPS upgrade flow that later calls _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
_upgradeToAndCallSecure delegatecalls into the new implementation, which can re-enter upgrade logic (rollback test).
_functionDelegateCall executes target.delegatecall, transferring control to arbitrary code.
sendValue performs a full-gas external call to a recipient, which may re-enter.
ballotOf reads hasVoted[issueId][addr].option.
getStatus reads issueMap[issueId].status.
weightedVoteCountsOf reads voteWeight[issueId][option].
fetchIssueMap returns the issueStruct stored in issueMap.
fetchIsExpired reads issueMap[_issue].endBlock.
fetchCtr returns _IssueCtr.current().
weightOf exposes the same balance quantity that feeds voteWeight.
endBlock argument flows into issueStruct.endBlock of the new proposal.
quorum argument flows into issueStruct.quorum after isValidquorum validation.
issueId indexes issueMap/hasVoted/voteWeight inside vote.
option selects the voteWeight bucket and is stored in hasVoted.
relayer address keys hasVoted and supplies the balance used as weight.
The local balance value is added into voteWeight and maxVotes.
The local yes value is multiplied by 10000 in the percentage computation.
yesPercent decides whether _setStatus(Passed) is executed inside vote.
issueId selects the proposal evaluated by setStatus.
The local yes value feeds the percentage arithmetic in setStatus.
yesPercent chooses between Passed and Cancelled outcomes in setStatus.
issueId indexes issueMap inside _setStatus.
option is written to issueMap[issueId].resultOption.
status is written to issueMap[issueId].status.
_b becomes the new bridge address, controlling all isBridge-gated functions.
account is the recipient argument of the privileged _mint call.
account is the target argument of the privileged _burn call.
issueId selects the passed proposal to mark as Executed.
newImplementation is the address passed to the upgrade execution path.

normalization_plan.reason: The endBlock argument only exists to populate issueStruct.endBlock; fold it into createProposal.
The quorum argument is validated by isValidquorum and stored; fold it into createProposal.
issueId is purely an indexing key for the vote logic; fold it into vote.
option is a validated selector used only inside vote; fold it into vote.
relayer keys hasVoted and provides the balance inside vote; fold it into vote.
The balance local is the direct operand of the voteWeight accumulation operation.
The yes local is the direct operand of the percentage division operation.
yesPercent is derived and compared only within vote; fold it into vote.
issueId indexes issueMap inside setStatus; fold it into setStatus.
The local yes value is the direct operand of the division operation shared by the status decision.
yesPercent is computed and consumed only inside setStatus; fold it into setStatus.
issueId only indexes issueMap inside _setStatus; fold it into _setStatus.
option is written directly into issueMap[issueId].resultOption by the status write operation.
status is written directly into issueMap[issueId].status by the status write operation.
_b is validated and assigned to the bridge state variable only inside setBridge.
account is the recipient argument of the privileged _mint(account, 1 ether) operation.
account is the target argument of the privileged _burn(account, 1 ether) operation.
issueId only selects the proposal record inside executeProposal; fold it into executeProposal.
newImplementation is the access-checked argument of the upgrade authorization gate; fold it into _authorizeUpgrade.
